class.name: OpenXRMetaSpatialEntitySharingExtension
class.description: Wraps the [code]XR_META_spatial_entity_sharing[/code] and [code]XR_META_spatial_entity_group_sharing[/code] extensions. Use this singleton to check whether the current runtime supports Meta spatial entity sharing in general, and group-based sharing specifically.

method.name: is_spatial_entity_group_sharing_supported
method.description: Checks if the runtime supports sharing spatial entities with application-defined group UUIDs.

method.name: is_spatial_entity_sharing_supported
method.description: Checks if the runtime supports Meta spatial entity sharing.
